headline: BLUE JAY GOLD HITS 14M AT 6.15 G/T AU + 124 G/T AG IN YUKON — RAINBOW ZONE EXTENDED 32M DOWN-PLUNGE
snippet: Blue Jay Gold Corp. (TSX-V: JAY) released maiden 2026 assay results from Skukum Creek at the Steller Gold Project in Yukon, with hole SC26-003 returning 14.00 metres at 6.15 g/t Au and 124 g/t Ag — a ~32-metre down-plunge extension of the Rainbow Zone beyond the 2021 discovery hole. Best sub-intercept was 10.50m at 7.84 g/t Au and 154 g/t Ag (10.19 g/t AuEq from 495m depth); follow-up holes are planned to test further down-plunge and along-strike extensions of this gold-silver system.

headline: TRX GOLD POSTS RECORD 8,173 OZ IN Q4, 29,650 OZ FY2026 — BUCKREEF 3,500 TPD MILL EXPANSION CONTRACTED
snippet: TRX Gold (TSX: TRX) delivered record Q4 FY2026 production of 8,173 oz — up 28% year-over-year — with full-year output of 29,650 oz (57% increase over FY2025) at the top of guidance. At an average Q4 gold price of $4,233/oz the margins are exceptional; TRX has also finalized contracts for a new 3,500 tpd SAG/Ball mill at Buckreef in Tanzania, targeting combined capacity above the 62,000 oz outlined in the project PEA once the expansion completes in 12–18 months.

headline: AXO METALS DRILLS 18M AT 8.15 G/T AU — STEP-OUT HITS HIGH GRADE 750M BEYOND SAPUCHI RESOURCE BOUNDARY
snippet: Axo Metals Corp (TSX-V: AXO) confirmed 18.0 metres grading 8.15 g/t Au at the Sapuchi deposit within its San Antonio Project in Sonora, Mexico, while initial step-out drilling encountered strong gold mineralization directly from surface 750 metres beyond the existing resource boundary. The high-grade near-surface hit extends the potential footprint of a project already carrying 576,000 oz Au indicated; additional step-out holes are assessing depth and lateral extent.

headline: GUARDIAN METAL CONFIRMS 200M TUNGSTEN STRIKE AT PILOT MOUNTAIN — 64M AT 0.20% WO3, TREMOR ZONE OPEN IN ALL DIRECTIONS
snippet: Guardian Metal Resources (LSE: GMET / OTC: GMTL) announced drill results from the newly discovered Tremor Zone and Good Hope Zone at its 100%-owned Pilot Mountain tungsten project in Nevada, confirming mineralization over 200 metres of strike — open in multiple directions. Best hole PM26-088 returned 64.15m at 0.20% WO3 including 14.27m at 0.34% WO3, supporting potential resource expansion beyond what was incorporated in the recently completed Pre-Feasibility Study.

headline: CANADA NICKEL PICKS KOMATSU FOR C$1.5B CRAWFORD FLEET — 300+ AUTONOMOUS TRUCKS OVER 40-YEAR MINE LIFE
snippet: Canada Nickel Company (TSX-V: CNC) selected Komatsu and SMS Equipment to supply the load-and-haul fleet for its proposed Crawford Nickel Project 40 km north of Timmins, Ontario — a C$1.5-billion commitment covering 300+ machines over a 40-year mine life, with definitive agreements targeted for Q1 2027. Crawford holds the world's second-largest nickel reserve; Komatsu was chosen for its autonomous haulage and electrification technology, aligning with Canada Nickel's low-carbon critical mineral mandate.

headline: FIRST MINING AND TRX GOLD ADDED TO GDXJ — PASSIVE VANECK INFLOWS TRIGGER AT SEPT 18 CLOSE
snippet: First Mining Gold (TSX: FF) and TRX Gold (TSX: TRX) both announced on September 14 they have been added to the MVIS Global Junior Gold Miners Index — the benchmark for the VanEck Junior Gold Miners ETF (GDXJ) — effective the close of September 18. Index inclusion obligates passive ETF managers to buy these stocks automatically, a mechanical demand event that historically generates measurable price outperformance in the days around the effective date.

headline: GOLD PINNED AT $4,285 AS 5% TREASURY YIELDS JOIN OIL SHOCK — DUAL HEADWIND ENTERS FOMC WEEK
snippet: Gold traded around $4,285 Monday evening as the 10-year US Treasury yield pushed toward 5% — a level historically associated with severe pressure on non-yielding assets — compounding the oil shock from Saudi Arabia's pipeline shutdown driving Brent near $108. The dual headwind creates a mechanically bearish near-term setup: rising real yields cut gold's opportunity cost advantage while oil-driven inflation expectations support further Fed tightening ahead of the Tuesday-Wednesday FOMC meeting.

headline: COT REPORT: GOLD SPECS NEAR MULTI-YEAR LONG PEAK ENTERING FED WEEK — SILVER POSITIONING DIVERGES
snippet: GoldSeek's September 11 Commitment of Traders analysis finds non-commercial net long positioning in gold futures near multi-year highs heading into the FOMC — a historically contrarian caution flag since crowded longs unwind sharply on hawkish surprises. Silver's speculative long position has not fully caught up despite silver's outperformance since June, a divergence that often precedes metals volatility; dollar index specs show growing short bets building ahead of Wednesday's rate decision.

headline: HIKE, HOLD, OR PIVOT: HOW WEDNESDAY'S FED CALL CHANGES THE MATH FOR GOLD AND MINING STOCKS
snippet: GoldSilver.com maps three September FOMC scenarios against gold and junior mining equity outcomes: a hike (87% priced in) likely triggers a 2–4% gold selloff before a relief rally; a hold sends gold back toward $4,400–4,500 as the no-hike surprise compresses the dollar; a dovish pivot — ruled out given 3.4% CPI — would push gold to new all-time highs above the August $4,691 peak. The analysis argues Wednesday's directional move has historically been the sector's most reliable 24-hour entry signal of the quarter.
